ex.en: Please return to your seat. We are experiencing some turbulence.
ex.zh: 請回到座位上，我們正遇到一些亂流。

ex.en: The turbulence made my coffee spill.
ex.zh: 亂流讓我的咖啡灑了出來。

ex.en: The company went through a period of financial turbulence.
ex.zh: 這家公司經歷了一段財務動盪期。

ex.en: Markets are still recovering from last year's turbulence.
ex.zh: 市場仍在從去年的動盪中恢復。
